lines.text: The brothers are urged, on account of God's mercy, to offer their bodies as living sacrifices.
We are not to be conformed to this world, but transformed by the renewing of our mind.
Paul says to think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith Peter has given you.
Paul says we who are many are one vine in Christ, and each member belongs to one another.
We have different gifts, and whoever shows mercy should do it cheerfully.
